_comment: What check-docs-drift must not treat as a repository path. `paths`: tokens that look like paths but are not tracked files on purpose — workflow artifacts that are WorkflowFile DB rows (research.md, plan.md, ...), gitignored build/runtime output, release artifacts made at publish time. `illustrativeNameDocs`: naming-policy docs whose bare file names are made-up examples (their real paths, anything containing '/', are still checked). A moved or deleted file belongs in the doc fix, not here.
